mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 77 degrees at Verona City Hall under a Waning Gibbous moon. For the star gazers, the ISS will be visible tonight starting at 3:31 AM, moving from the Northwest near Verona High School toward the East Northeast over Fitchburg. Expect a low of 69 degrees tonight with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona recently installed the Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture at Century School Park. This public art, commissioned by Gerri Gurman and carved by local artists, features animal figures inspired by Tai Chi. The city plans to add multilingual signage and native landscaping to the site soon.

There is plenty to do in town. Today, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the lineup includes yoga, the downtown farmer's market, and more trivia at The Bogey Factory.

In our weekly police report, on August 30, officers responded to a report of a vehicle window being smashed on North Edge Trail. The suspect was identified, and an arrest warrant was issued after it was determined he was on probation at the time of the incident.

Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store is currently open but will be closing soon in 39 minutes, so be sure to stop by before they shut their doors for the night.
